| projectId | the project whose question or Advisor answer showed no_active_index | "none" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "Index check incomplete: <tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was changed."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Index freshness needs an LPM API key. On this connector I can only list the repository links; their lastScanAt is a metadata scan, not the code index."
2. CALL `list_workspace_repository_links` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","includeArchived":true} [A]
   IF <input:repository> == "all" → go to step 6.
   SAVE: linkId = id of the item whose id == <input:repository> or whose canonicalRepositoryUrl == <input:repository> in lower case without a trailing ".git", and whose archivedAt is empty; url = its canonicalRepositoryUrl; hidden = its agentVisible == false; mappings = its projectMappings; creator = its credentialOwnerId; scanCommit = its lastKnownCommit; scanAt = its lastScanAt
   IF no item matches → STOP. Say: "<input:repository> has no active workspace repository link, so no agent can search its code (that is what no_active_index means). Link it with playbook link? (yes/no)"
   IF <saved:hidden> is true → STOP. Say: "Link <saved:linkId> is hidden from agents (agentVisible false), so code search skips it. Make it visible with playbook change-link? (yes/no)"
3. IF <input:projectId> is not "none" and no item of <saved:mappings> has projectId == <input:projectId> with agentVisible not false → STOP. Say: "<saved:url> is not mapped to project <input:projectId>, so code search and the Advisor for that project see nothing (no_active_index). Add the mapping with playbook change-link? (yes/no)"
4. CALL `reconcile_workspace_code_indexes` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error that contains "permission" → go to step 5.
   IF the call returns an error that contains "Private" or "non-public" → STOP. Say: "LPM cannot read <saved:url> on GitHub. The link creator (credentialOwnerId <saved:creator>) needs a personal GitHub credential in LPM, or an LPM admin must install the GitHub App."
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Index check incomplete: reconcile_workspace_code_indexes failed: <error text>."
   SAVE: state, indexedCommitSha, repositoryCommitSha = those fields of the item of result.results with repositoryLinkId == <saved:linkId> (no such item → state = "not checked")
   VERIFY: CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.pointer.expectedRepositoryCommitSha (empty when pointer is null) != <saved:indexedCommitSha> (empty when null) → STOP. Say: "The index of <saved:url> changed during the check. Run this playbook again."
   SAVE: activeId = result.pointer.activeIndexVersionId ("none" when pointer is null); generation = result.pointer.generation (0 when pointer is null); go to Answer.
5. CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   SAVE: activeId = result.pointer.activeIndexVersionId ("none" when pointer is null); indexedCommitSha = result.pointer.expectedRepositoryCommitSha ("none" when pointer is null); repositoryCommitSha = "<saved:scanCommit> (scan of <saved:scanAt>)"; state = "missing" when pointer is null, else "indicative only: no owner/admin right to compare with GitHub"; go to Answer.
6. CALL `reconcile_workspace_code_indexes` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error that contains "permission" → STOP. Say: "Only a workspace owner or admin can check every repository. Name one repository and I will read its index."
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Index check incomplete: one repository failed, so the whole check failed (<error text>). Name one repository to check it alone."
   SAVE: results = one line per item of result.results: "<repositoryUrl>: <state> (indexed <indexedCommitSha>, branch head <repositoryCommitSha>)"; checkedIds = the repositoryLinkId of each item of result.results
   VERIFY: CALL `list_workspace_repository_links` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result is empty → STOP. Say: "Index check incomplete: the workspace has no active repository link to check."
   SAVE: notChecked = canonicalRepositoryUrl of each item of result whose id is not in <saved:checkedIds> (hidden from agents, or beyond the first 25 links)

```text
Pending: <none | not checked: <saved:notChecked> | owner/admin must confirm freshness — read with an owner/admin key>
```

state: missing | stale | current, from reconcile_workspace_code_indexes. Never claim "current" for a repository that reconcile did not return with state current; lastScanAt and lastKnownCommit are never index freshness.

   IF <saved:wsLinkId> is not empty → STOP. Say: "<input:repositoryUrl> is already linked to the workspace as <saved:wsLinkId>. Change it with playbook change-link; a second link is never created."

You become its credential owner; GitHub access: <saved:access>. Call: create_workspace_repository_link(workspaceId=<input:workspaceId>, repositoryUrl=<input:repositoryUrl>, defaultBranch=<input:branch>, projectMappings=[that mapping]) (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.

   IF the call returns an error that contains "permission" or the error is JSON-RPC -32003 → STOP. Say: "Only a workspace owner or admin with a full or custom API key can link at workspace level. Ask one, or link it to one project for metadata only (no code search)."

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace? (id)" |
| repository | the user: `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>` or a repository link id | STOP. Say: "Which repository? (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> or link id)" |
| level | "project" when the link belongs to one project, else "workspace" | "workspace" |
| projectId | the project that owns a project link | level "project" → STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id)"; else "none" |
| vault | "yes" only when a workspace owner/admin explicitly asked to scan with the workspace GitHub token | "no" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was scanned."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "A scan needs an LPM API key; this connector cannot scan."
2. SAVE: source = "workspace" when <input:vault> == "yes", else "default"
   IF <input:vault> == "no" → go to step 4.
3. CALL `get_workspace_repository_credential` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   IF result.configured != true → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-access.md`. Say: "No workspace GitHub token is configured in <input:workspaceId>."
4. IF <input:level> == "project" → go to step 7.
5. CALL `list_workspace_repository_links` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: linkId = id of the item whose id == <input:repository> or whose canonicalRepositoryUrl == <input:repository> in lower case without a trailing ".git"; url = its canonicalRepositoryUrl
   IF no item matches → STOP. Say: "<input:repository> has no active workspace link. Link it first with playbook link."
6. CALL `scan_workspace_repository_readonly` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>","credentialSource":"<saved:source>"} [A]
   Make this call once. A failed scan still counts toward the 10 scans per workspace hour; never repeat it in a loop.
   IF the call returns an error that contains "rate limit" → STOP. Say: "The workspace used its 10 scans of this hour. Scan again in up to one hour."
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "The scan of <saved:url> failed: <error text>. It still counted toward the hourly limit; I did not repeat it."
   SAVE: branch, commitSha, visibility, scannedAt = those fields of result
   VERIFY: CALL `list_workspace_repository_links` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:linkId> has lastScanStatus != "completed" → STOP. Say: "Link <saved:linkId> shows lastScanStatus <lastScanStatus>, not completed."
   SAVE: next = "a scan never refreshes the code index: check it with playbook check"; go to Answer.
7. CALL `list_project_repository_links` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: linkId = id of the item whose id == <input:repository> or whose canonicalRepositoryUrl == <input:repository> in lower case without a trailing ".git"; url = its canonicalRepositoryUrl
   IF no item matches → STOP. Say: "<input:repository> has no active link in project <input:projectId>. Link it first with playbook link."
8. CALL `scan_project_repository_readonly` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>","credentialSource":"<saved:source>"} [A]
   Make this call once. A failed scan still counts toward the 10 scans per workspace hour; never repeat it in a loop.
   IF the call returns an error that contains "rate limit" → STOP. Say: "The workspace used its 10 scans of this hour. Scan again in up to one hour."
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "The scan of <saved:url> failed: <error text>. It still counted toward the hourly limit; I did not repeat it."
   SAVE: branch, commitSha, visibility, scannedAt = those fields of result
   VERIFY: CALL `list_project_repository_links` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:linkId> has lastScanStatus != "completed" → STOP. Say: "Link <saved:linkId> shows lastScanStatus <lastScanStatus>, not completed."
   SAVE: next = "none — scan done (a project link never gets a code index)"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId> / <saved:url> (<input:level> link <saved:linkId>)
Done: <scanned <saved:url>: branch <saved:branch>, commit <saved:commitSha>, <saved:visibility>, at <saved:scannedAt>; credential <saved:source> | nothing scanned>
Evidence: <lastScanStatus completed, read after the scan | none>
```

lastScanStatus: never_scanned | completed | failed | rate_limited. Never claim a scan that the VERIFY above did not list as completed; a scan is metadata only and older than 24 h it is stale.


## § flow-refresh

## Playbook: refresh
Use when: build and activate a new code index (missing or stale)

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace? (id)" |
| repository | the user: `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>` or a workspace link id | STOP. Say: "Which repository? (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>)" |
| date | today's UTC date as yyyy-mm-dd | — |
| smokeQuery | a file name in this repository the user named (never the repository name) | "README.md" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. The active code index was not changed."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "A refresh needs an owner/admin LPM API key."
2. CALL `list_workspace_repository_links` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: linkId = id of the item whose id == <input:repository> or whose canonicalRepositoryUrl == <input:repository> in lower case without ".git"; url = its canonicalRepositoryUrl; creator = its credentialOwnerId; key = "manual:<input:date>:<saved:linkId>"
   IF no item matches or it has agentVisible == false → STOP. Say: "<input:repository> has no visible workspace link. Run playbook link or change-link first."
3. CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   SAVE: oldGeneration = result.pointer.generation; oldActiveId = result.pointer.activeIndexVersionId; oldCommit = result.pointer.expectedRepositoryCommitSha (pointer null → 0, "none", "none")
4. CALL `preview_repository_code_index` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error that contains "Private" → STOP. Say: "LPM cannot read <saved:url>: link creator <saved:creator> needs a personal GitHub credential in LPM, or an LPM admin the GitHub App."
   SAVE: commitSha, selectedFileCount, truncated = those fields of result
   VERIFY: CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.pointer.generation (pointer null → 0) != <saved:oldGeneration> → STOP. Say: "The index changed meanwhile. Run this playbook again."
   IF <saved:commitSha> == <saved:oldCommit> → STOP. Say: "<saved:url> is already indexed at the branch head <saved:commitSha> (version <saved:oldActiveId>)."
5. ASK: "Build a code index of <saved:url> at <saved:commitSha> (<saved:selectedFileCount> files, truncated <saved:truncated>; up to 9 min)? refresh_repository_code_index(workspaceId=<input:workspaceId>, repositoryLinkId=<saved:linkId>, commitSha=<saved:commitSha>, idempotencyKey=<saved:key>) (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
   A yes the user already wrote for this refresh ("I confirm") counts: go on.
6. CALL `refresh_repository_code_index` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>","commitSha":"<saved:commitSha>","idempotencyKey":"<saved:key>"} [C]
   IF the call returns an error that contains "document cap" → STOP. Say: "<saved:url> exceeds the 5,000-chunk build cap: an owner decision on LPM platform configuration. Nothing was activated."
   IF the call returns an error that contains "timeout" or "timed out" → STOP. Say: "The build may still run. Wait 10 minutes, then run this playbook again (same commit and key, same version)."
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "refresh failed: <error text>. Nothing was activated."
   SAVE: versionId = result.id; built = result.status; files = result.indexedFiles; chunks = result.searchableChunkCount
   VERIFY: CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.pointer.activeIndexVersionId (pointer null → "none") != <saved:oldActiveId> → STOP. Say: "The active index changed during the build. Run playbook check."
   SAVE: generation = result.pointer.generation (pointer null → 0)
   IF <saved:built> != "validating" → STOP. Say: "Build <saved:versionId> is <saved:built>, not validating; nothing was activated."
7. ASK: "Make <saved:versionId> (<saved:files> files, commit <saved:commitSha>) the live index of <saved:url> for every agent and the Advisor? activate_repository_code_index(workspaceId=<input:workspaceId>, versionId=<saved:versionId>, expectedGeneration=<saved:generation>) (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
   A yes the user already wrote for the activation ("I confirm both steps") counts: go on.
8. CALL `activate_repository_code_index` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","versionId":"<saved:versionId>","expectedGeneration":"<saved:generation>"} [C] (send <saved:generation> as a JSON number: 4, not "4")
   Send it once; never re-send it, even after an error: the VERIFY decides.
   VERIFY: CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.pointer.activeIndexVersionId != <saved:versionId> → STOP. Say: "<saved:versionId> is not active; activate was not re-sent. Run playbook check."
   SAVE: newGeneration = result.pointer.generation; activeCommit = result.pointer.expectedRepositoryCommitSha
9. CALL `search_workspace_code` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","query":"<input:smokeQuery>","limit":10} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → SAVE: smoke = "not run (<error text>)"; go to Answer.
   SAVE: smoke = "<path> (link <saved:linkId>, commit <saved:activeCommit>, lexicalMatch true)" of the first result with repositoryLinkId == <saved:linkId>, commitSha == <saved:activeCommit> and lexicalMatch == true (missing = false), else "inconclusive"
   VERIFY: CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.pointer.activeIndexVersionId != <saved:versionId> → STOP. Say: "<saved:versionId> is no longer active. Run playbook check."

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId> / <saved:url> (link <saved:linkId>)
Done: <activated <saved:versionId> at <saved:activeCommit>, generation <saved:oldGeneration> -> <saved:newGeneration>; state after: current | nothing activated; state after: unchanged>
Evidence: <files <saved:files>, chunks <saved:chunks>, previous <saved:oldActiveId>; smoke <saved:smoke> | none>
Pending: <none | smoke <saved:smoke> — search <input:smokeQuery> again after 00:00 UTC>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | none — index current at <saved:activeCommit>>
```
state after: current | unchanged; version states: validating | active | superseded | failed. Never claim a version, commit or generation that a VERIFY did not read (never from the activate response).

   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "A rollback needs an LPM API key (profile full or custom) of a workspace owner or admin; this connector cannot do it."
2. CALL `list_workspace_repository_links` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: linkId = id of the item whose id == <input:repository> or whose canonicalRepositoryUrl == <input:repository> in lower case without a trailing ".git"; url = that item's canonicalRepositoryUrl
   IF no item matches → STOP. Say: "<input:repository> has no active workspace repository link, so it has no code index to roll back."
3. CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF result.pointer is null → STOP. Say: "<saved:url> was never indexed; there is nothing to roll back."
   SAVE: generation = result.pointer.generation; activeId = result.pointer.activeIndexVersionId; previousId = result.pointer.previousIndexVersionId (empty when null); oldCommit = result.pointer.expectedRepositoryCommitSha; previousCommit = the commitSha of the item of result.versions with id == <saved:previousId>
   IF <saved:previousId> is empty → STOP. Say: "<saved:url> has no previous index version, so a rollback is impossible. A new build is possible with playbook refresh."
4. ASK: "Roll back the code index of <saved:url> from version <saved:activeId> (commit <saved:oldCommit>) to the older version <saved:previousId> (commit <saved:previousCommit>)? Code search and the Advisor will show the older code. Call: rollback_repository_code_index(workspaceId=<input:workspaceId>, repositoryLinkId=<saved:linkId>, expectedGeneration=<saved:generation>) (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
   A yes the user already wrote for this rollback ("I confirm", "confirmo") counts: continue without asking.
5. CALL `rollback_repository_code_index` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>","expectedGeneration":"<saved:generation>"} [C] (send <saved:generation> as a JSON number: 4, not "4")
   Send it once. A second rollback swaps back to the version you just replaced; never re-send it, even after an error.
   IF the call returns an error that contains "content is unavailable" → STOP. Say: "Version <saved:previousId> was purged, so it cannot come back. A new build is possible with playbook refresh."
   VERIFY: CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.pointer.activeIndexVersionId != <saved:previousId> → STOP. Say: "The rollback is not confirmed: the active version is <result.pointer.activeIndexVersionId>. I did not re-send it."
   SAVE: newGeneration = result.pointer.generation; activeCommit = result.pointer.expectedRepositoryCommitSha

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId> / <saved:url> (link <saved:linkId>)
Done: <rolled back to <saved:previousId> at <saved:activeCommit>, generation <saved:generation> -> <saved:newGeneration>; state after: stale | nothing changed>
Evidence: <active <saved:previousId> read after the rollback; replaced version <saved:activeId> (commit <saved:oldCommit>) is now the previous version | none>
Pending: <none | the index shows older code until the next build — GitHub push, daily job or playbook refresh>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | none — rollback done; do not roll back again (it would re-activate <saved:activeId>)>
```
state after a rollback: stale (the restored version covers an older commit). Never claim an active version or generation that step 5's VERIFY did not read.


## § flow-purge

## Playbook: purge
Use when: delete the content of one old index version

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace? (id)" |
| versionId | the user, or the `id` a refresh returned earlier in this conversation; never an id from get_repository_index_status (the active and previous versions are never purgeable) | STOP. Say: "Which version id? Old versions are purged automatically after 30 days; nothing to do otherwise." |
| reason | the user's words, at least 10 characters | STOP. Say: "Why delete version <input:versionId>? (one sentence)" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was deleted."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "A purge needs an LPM API key (profile full or custom) of a workspace owner or admin; this connector cannot do it."
2. IF <input:reason> has fewer than 10 characters → STOP. Say: "The reason must have at least 10 characters. Why delete version <input:versionId>?"
3. ASK: "Check whether version <input:versionId> can be purged (dry run; it deletes nothing)? Call: purge_repository_code_index(workspaceId=<input:workspaceId>, versionId=<input:versionId>, reason=<input:reason>, dryRun=true) (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
   The user's request to purge this version counts as yes for this dry run: continue without asking.
4. CALL `purge_repository_code_index` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","versionId":"<input:versionId>","reason":"<input:reason>","dryRun":true} [C]
   SAVE: linkId = result.repositoryLinkId; eligible = result.eligibility.eligible; reasons = result.eligibility.reasons; ageDays = result.eligibility.ageDays; documents = result.documentCount
   VERIFY: CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.pointer.activeIndexVersionId == <input:versionId> → STOP. Say: "Version <input:versionId> is the active index; it can never be purged."
   SAVE: activeId = result.pointer.activeIndexVersionId
   IF <saved:eligible> is false → STOP. Say: "Version <input:versionId> cannot be purged: <saved:reasons> (age <saved:ageDays> days). LPM purges old versions automatically after 30 days. A leaked secret in a recent or rollback version is an incident for the owner and an LPM admin; I will not work around it."
5. ASK: "Delete the stored search content of version <input:versionId> (<saved:documents> files) forever? It can never be rolled back to. Reason: <input:reason>. Call: purge_repository_code_index(workspaceId=<input:workspaceId>, versionId=<input:versionId>, reason=<input:reason>, dryRun=false) (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
   Always ask this question, even when the request already said yes: only a yes after this exact question counts.
6. CALL `purge_repository_code_index` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","versionId":"<input:versionId>","reason":"<input:reason>","dryRun":false} [C]
   SAVE: purgedAt = result.contentPurgedAt (empty when absent)
   VERIFY: CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.pointer.activeIndexVersionId != <saved:activeId> → STOP. Say: "The active index changed during the purge (now <result.pointer.activeIndexVersionId>). Check it with playbook check."
   IF <saved:purgedAt> is empty → STOP. Say: "The purge of <input:versionId> returned no contentPurgedAt; it may have failed at the provider. It can be retried."

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId> / version <input:versionId> (link <saved:linkId>)
Done: <purged <input:versionId> at <saved:purgedAt> | dry run only, nothing deleted>; active version <saved:activeId> unchanged
Evidence: <eligibility <saved:eligible>, reasons <saved:reasons>, <saved:documents> files, age <saved:ageDays> days | none>
Pending: <none | incident: secret in a version that cannot be purged — owner and LPM admin>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | none — version purged>
```
reasons: active-version | rollback-version | non-terminal-version | incident-hold | purge-in-progress | already-purged | retention-window. Never claim a purge without contentPurgedAt from step 6.


## § flow-compare

## Playbook: compare
Use when: list files changed between two commits

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace? (id)" |
| repository | the user: `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>` or a workspace repository link id | STOP. Say: "Which repository? (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> or link id)" |
| base | a full 40-character SHA from the user, or "index" (the commit of the active code index) | "index" |
| head | a full 40-character SHA from the user, or "branch" (the current head of the link's branch) | "branch" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was compared."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Comparing commits needs an LPM API key; this connector cannot do it."
2. IF <input:base> is neither "index" nor 40 hexadecimal characters → STOP. Say: "I need full 40-character SHAs; a short SHA cannot be compared. Which base commit?"
   IF <input:head> is neither "branch" nor 40 hexadecimal characters → STOP. Say: "I need full 40-character SHAs; a short SHA cannot be compared. Which head commit?"
3. CALL `list_workspace_repository_links` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: linkId = id of the item whose id == <input:repository> or whose canonicalRepositoryUrl == <input:repository> in lower case without a trailing ".git"; url = its canonicalRepositoryUrl
   IF no item matches → STOP. Say: "<input:repository> has no active workspace link; only workspace links can be compared (project link ids fail)."
4. CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   SAVE: indexCommit = result.pointer.expectedRepositoryCommitSha (empty when pointer is null); base = <saved:indexCommit> when <input:base> == "index", else <input:base>; head = <input:head>
   IF <saved:base> is empty → STOP. Say: "<saved:url> has no active code index, so there is no index commit. Which base commit? (40 characters)"
   IF <input:head> != "branch" → go to step 6.
5. CALL `preview_repository_code_index` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   SAVE: head = result.commitSha
   VERIFY: CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.pointer.expectedRepositoryCommitSha (empty when pointer is null) != <saved:indexCommit> → STOP. Say: "The active index of <saved:url> changed meanwhile. Run this playbook again."
6. CALL `compare_repository_commits` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>","baseCommitSha":"<saved:base>","headCommitSha":"<saved:head>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error that contains "could not be resolved" → STOP. Say: "GitHub does not know one of the commits <saved:base> / <saved:head> in <saved:url>, or LPM has no GitHub access to it (GitHub App or the link creator's credential)."
   SAVE: relation, aheadBy, behindBy, truncated = result.status, result.aheadBy, result.behindBy, result.truncated; files = one "<path> (<status>, +<additions> -<deletions>)" per item of result.files
   VERIFY: CALL `get_repository_index_status` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.pointer.expectedRepositoryCommitSha (empty when pointer is null) != <saved:indexCommit> → STOP. Say: "The active index of <saved:url> changed during the comparison. Run this playbook again."

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId> / <saved:url> (link <saved:linkId>): <saved:base> .. <saved:head>
Done: read-only comparison, nothing changed
Evidence: <<saved:relation>, ahead <saved:aheadBy>, behind <saved:behindBy>; files: <saved:files>; truncated <saved:truncated> | none>
Pending: <none | more than 100 files changed — only the first 100 are listed>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | none — comparison done | build the index at <saved:head> with playbook refresh (base is the index commit and files changed)>
```
relation: ahead | behind | identical | diverged. Never claim a file list that step 6 did not return; it has names and line counts only, no code.


## § flow-change-link

## Playbook: change-link
Use when: change branch or project mappings, or unhide a link

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace? (id)" |
| repository | the user: `https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>` or a repository link id | STOP. Say: "Which repository? (https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> or link id)" |
| level | "project" when the link belongs to one project (list_project_repository_links), else "workspace" | "workspace" |
| projectId | the project to map, unmap, or that owns a project link | "none"; level "project" → STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id)" |
| mapping | "add" or "remove" <input:projectId> from the workspace link's mappings, or "keep" | "keep" |
| repositoryPath | the folder of <input:projectId> inside the repository | "" (whole repository) |
| branch | the new default branch the user named, or "keep" | "keep" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. The link was not changed."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF result.credential == "oauth" → STOP. Say: "Changing a repository link needs an LPM API key (profile full or custom); this connector cannot do it."
2. IF <input:level> == "project" → go to step 6.
3. CALL `list_workspace_repository_links` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: linkId = id of the item whose id == <input:repository> or whose canonicalRepositoryUrl == <input:repository> in lower case without a trailing ".git"; url = its canonicalRepositoryUrl; oldBranch = its defaultBranch ("" when null); oldVisible = its agentVisible; oldMappings = its projectMappings, the whole array exactly as listed
   IF no item matches → STOP. Say: "<input:repository> has no active workspace link (an archived link cannot be edited). Link it again with playbook link (new id, no index)."
   SAVE: newBranch = <saved:oldBranch> when <input:branch> == "keep", else <input:branch>
   SAVE: newMappings = <saved:oldMappings> with these changes only: mapping "add" → if an item has projectId == <input:projectId>, set its agentVisible true and its repositoryPath to <input:repositoryPath>; else append {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","repositoryPath":"<input:repositoryPath>"}; mapping "remove" → drop the item with projectId == <input:projectId>; "keep" → no change
4. ASK: "Change workspace link <saved:linkId> (<saved:url>)? defaultBranch: "<saved:oldBranch>" → "<saved:newBranch>"; agentVisible: <saved:oldVisible> → true; projectMappings now: <saved:oldMappings> → after: <saved:newMappings> (the array is replaced as a whole). Call: update_workspace_repository_link(workspaceId=<input:workspaceId>, repositoryLinkId=<saved:linkId>, defaultBranch=<saved:newBranch>, agentVisible=true, projectMappings=<saved:newMappings>) (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
5. CALL `update_workspace_repository_link` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>","defaultBranch":"<saved:newBranch>","agentVisible":true,"projectMappings":"<saved:newMappings>"} [C] (send <saved:newMappings> as a JSON array, not as a string)
   VERIFY: CALL `list_workspace_repository_links` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:linkId> has another defaultBranch (null equals ""), agentVisible false, or misses a projectId of <saved:newMappings> → STOP. Say: "Link <saved:linkId> does not show the change; check its projectMappings in the LPM web app."
   SAVE: kept = the projectMappings of item <saved:linkId>; go to Answer.
6. CALL `list_project_repository_links` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: linkId = id of the item whose id == <input:repository> or whose canonicalRepositoryUrl == <input:repository> in lower case without a trailing ".git"; url = its canonicalRepositoryUrl; oldBranch = its defaultBranch ("" when null); oldVisible = its agentVisible
   IF no item matches → STOP. Say: "<input:repository> has no active link in project <input:projectId>."
   SAVE: newBranch = <saved:oldBranch> when <input:branch> == "keep", else <input:branch>
7. ASK: "Change project link <saved:linkId> (<saved:url>) of <input:projectId>? defaultBranch: "<saved:oldBranch>" → "<saved:newBranch>"; agentVisible: <saved:oldVisible> → true. Call: update_project_repository_link(projectId=<input:projectId>, repositoryLinkId=<saved:linkId>, defaultBranch=<saved:newBranch>, agentVisible=true) (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
8. CALL `update_project_repository_link` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","repositoryLinkId":"<saved:linkId>","defaultBranch":"<saved:newBranch>","agentVisible":true} [C]
   VERIFY: CALL `list_project_repository_links` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or item <saved:linkId> has another defaultBranch (null equals "") or agentVisible false → STOP. Say: "Project link <saved:linkId> does not show the change."
   SAVE: kept = "none (project link)"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId> / <saved:url> (<input:level> link <saved:linkId>)
Done: <changed link <saved:linkId>: defaultBranch <saved:newBranch>, agentVisible true | nothing changed>
Evidence: <listed after the change; projectMappings <saved:kept> | none>
Pending: <none | a new branch is not indexed yet — playbook refresh>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | none — mapping changes reach code search at once | build the index of the new branch with playbook refresh>
```
Never claim a change that the VERIFY above did not list; to hide or archive a link use playbook unlink.


## § flow-unlink

| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |

### Steps

3. CALL `list_workspace_repository_links` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: linkId = id of the item whose id == <input:repository> or whose canonicalRepositoryUrl == <input:repository> in lower case without a trailing ".git"; url = its canonicalRepositoryUrl
